handoff_instructions: Re-applied the previous run's wip patch (git apply --3way, clean) and finished M2-T20: receptionist tool-calls runtime. Changes: apps/web voice webhook route now answers call.tool_calls synchronously via executeReceptionistToolCalls (packages/workflows/src/receptionist-runtime.ts), executing lookup_business_info/create_lead/create_callback_task/request_transfer as the new RECEPTIONIST_AGENT actor (green-permission-only). lookupBusinessInfo (packages/core/src/services/receptionist.ts) reads only the one whitelisted receptionist.config field per topic, gated by new receptionist.lookup permission (agent-callable). create_lead and create_callback_task are made idempotent per `vapi:tool_call:${toolCall.id}` (createTask gained the same organization_id+idempotency_key upsert-or-return pattern leads already had; new migration 0013_task_idempotency.sql adds tasks.idempotency_key + partial unique index). Vapi adapter now parses toolCallList function name/arguments and builds the toolCallId-keyed response (packages/integrations). Fixed one pre-existing test in packages/agents that broke because create_callback_task's input now requires idempotencyKey. Added tests: packages/workflows/test/receptionist-runtime.test.ts (new describe executeReceptionistToolCalls — redelivery creates exactly one lead/one task, forbidden/unconfigured info is never invented, mutation is audited exactly once), packages/core/test/{receptionist,callback-tasks}.test.ts, packages/integrations/test/vapi.test.ts, packages/workflows/test/ingestion.test.ts. format:check/lint/typecheck/test all pass. Next: M2-T21 (transfer-destination-request / warm transfer).
